perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.desc: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): Backup PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Mistral Lift is an adaptive burst linear fusion rifle, which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being "worse DPS than even upper-middle special weapons and no access to ammo return perks". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, fires a 3-round burst as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are low by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/270610849/mistral-lift and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/270610849 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil direction is slightly right and reasonably tight so you could improve recoil control or just look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery with a Backup Mag mod or Ionized Battery gets you the maximum of 7 shots. To be honest, adaptive burst LFRs are a weak subfamily for boss damage but, if you insist, in the first trait perk column, Overflow refills the battery and boosts its capacity to ×2 of base (×2.2 when enhanced), rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick, or Reconstruction refills 25% of the battery every 6s (5.5s enhanced) up to ×2 capacity when stowed or not firing. For damage, in the second column Reservoir Burst provides a ×1.3 (×1.33 enhanced) damage boost when the battery is at or above maximum base capacity and triggers an AoE explosion on a kill, as well as passively granting +30 to Battery Capacity - the equivalent of a Backup Mag mod. The Veist Stinger is the best choice of origin trait for a boss damage roll, providing a 10% chance per hit to refill 25% of the battery, or Dawning Surprise has a hidden counter - 6 red bar kills (5 enhanced) or 2 orange/yellow bars will fill this to generate a pickup which lasts 10s that grants 10% energy to melee, grenade and super, +22 HP and start regeneration, so is less useful here. If you're interested, a mistral is a strong, cold, north-westerly wind that blows through France into the Mediterranean. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Backup Mag or Charge Time mod, or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained damage to bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Mistral Lift is an adaptive LFR which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic having been seriously power crept by crossbows and heavy disruptor snipers, so this is more to think about keeping in case there's a future rebalancing. The stats are low by comparison with its peers - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/766122634 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Look for a barrel perk that helps Handling, and then a battery perk that helps with charge time or magazine size. For a classic sustained boss damage roll for longer DPS windows, ignore the weird collection of add clearing trait perks, and go with Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch, which both proc on dealing damage with both of your other weapons to refill the magazine from reserves and boost damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s when enhanced). For the Origin Trait, Dawning Surprise has a hidden counter - 6 red bar kills (5 enhanced) or 2 orange/yellow bars will fill this to generate a pickup which last 10s that grants 10% energy to melee, grenade and super, +22 HP and start regeneration, so can be very useful or Field Test provides steady boosts to Range, Stability, Handling and Reload Speed on hits and kills, lasting until you die. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with Backup Mag or your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 126 from 17 December 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6SVRlV4ttvPkAm9HA44Km0?si=a9d7a25536b747c3) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for boss damage in general, and end-game underleveled content. Mistral Lift has decent stats, and a whole stack of boss damage trait perk options. At base - 40 Handling equates to a 0.46s ready 0.37s ADS time and 0.37s stow time, and 26 Reload Speed is a 2.39s reload. Magazine size is 5 (max 7) and with 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 23/24/26/26 (max 26). To help control the recoil, Arrowhead Brake straightens Recoil Direction to 100 and adds handling or, if you can handle the recoil, Fluted Barrel works too. Extended Battery and a Backup Mag mod gets you to 7 shots. For boss damage, Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch are a perfect pairing - rotate through your weapons to reload and boost damage by ×1.3 for 10s. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is pretty potent for PvE (although it won't proc much during boss damage) - 6 Minor add rapid kills drops a "gift" for your fireteam which on pickup grants +20% energy to all your abilities, restores 22HP and starts health regeneration. Recommended MW: Charge Time or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

Panda (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Not only will Mistral Lift, lift your spire. It will also be one hell of a good heavy weapon to bring into damage rotations. Enhanced Battery gives us extra in the mag without sacrificing reload, though Ionized Battery is also okay. Withering Gaze will proc Weaken on your first hit buffing the follow up two shots in your burst. Add in a stacking damage bonus through Precision Instrument and you've got yourself an incredibly strong weapon for solo or group activities." Recommended MW: Reload.

Panda (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While not Doomed Petitioner for PvP, Mistral Lift does have some utility in Keep Away or Moving Target and High-Impact Reserves for bonus damage on those last shots. You'll almost never be at max mag so there's no downside. Drop that charge time to have a nuclear sniper with better body shot damage." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

Stallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Truthfully, Envious and BnS just work. The two go together like gingerbread and.. Me. Everything else is just icing. More handling for better feeling BnS swaps, but truthfully it could be more charge time too, if that's your jam. Personally, I will be looking for either/or, because farming these is a nuisance." Recommended MW: Handling.
